args.lesson: Worked: before drafting, I reread the full OCDS release.description rather than the prior brief. It showed that the Croydon notice is an advance transparency notice: the 5 Nov date is a template placeholder and the extension is not executed. So the earlier 'Signed 2026-11-05' was wrong for public copy; the page corrects it. Splitting the work also helped: HTML went in as separate argv items (each under 8 KB) in one EXEC, and the source-verification EXEC was separate. Failed: one structured check used too narrow a JSON path suffix (classification.id missed additionalClassifications.id). A direct source probe fixed it. When a verifier fails, probe the source before changing the page. Limits: the private responder cannot fetch new data, so the offer is expression-of-interest only, with no sample promised. Dry_run digest 1c3f5a19... awaits independent review; nothing is deployed, the 14-day window has not started, and demand is unknown.
